designationHistory.indexText: Atchafalaya National Wildlife Refuge, established in 1984, is located in the floodplain of the Atchafalaya River, a tributary of the Mississippi that flows into the Gulf of Mexico.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
